question: 哪些站點有 C-320 這款 CT？各自收到幾件相關客訴、其中幾件已連到 CAPA？
gold_sql: SELECT s.site_id, s.name, ct.scanner_id, ct.installed_at, ct.default_slice_thickness_mm, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaints, COUNT(c.capa_id) AS linked_to_capa FROM ct_scanners ct JOIN sites s ON s.site_id = ct.site_id LEFT JOIN complaints c ON c.scanner_id = ct.scanner_id WHERE ct.model = 'C-320' GROUP BY s.site_id, s.name, ct.scanner_id, ct.installed_at, ct.default_slice_thickness_mm ORDER BY ct.installed_at;

question: 哪些 CT 的預設切片厚度超過同站點部署版本的輸入規格上限？
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT ct.site_id, ct.scanner_id, ct.model, ct.default_slice_thickness_mm, r.max_slice_thickness_mm FROM ct_scanners ct JOIN appliances a ON a.site_id = ct.site_id JOIN deployments dep ON dep.serial_no = a.serial_no JOIN software_releases r ON r.version = dep.version WHERE ct.default_slice_thickness_mm > r.max_slice_thickness_mm ORDER BY ct.site_id;

question: 醫院B 在 2026-03 到 2026-09 每個月的處理量、QC 拒收率和每例標記數？
gold_sql: SELECT month, studies_processed, qc_reject_rate, marks_per_study FROM monthly_usage WHERE site_id = 'H-B' AND month BETWEEN '2026-03' AND '2026-09' ORDER BY month;

question: 用到 SSD 批號 SSD-S1-L2508 的主機有哪些？各在哪個站點、已經發生幾次 SSD 故障？
gold_sql: SELECT a.serial_no, a.site_id, s.name, a.build_date, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS ssd_failures FROM appliance_parts ap JOIN appliances a ON a.serial_no = ap.serial_no JOIN sites s ON s.site_id = a.site_id LEFT JOIN complaints c ON c.serial_no = a.serial_no AND c.suspected_component = 'SSD' WHERE ap.lot_no = 'SSD-S1-L2508' GROUP BY a.serial_no, a.site_id, s.name, a.build_date ORDER BY ssd_failures DESC, a.serial_no;

question: 每個 SSD 批號裝在幾台主機上、其中幾台發生過 SSD 故障、比例多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ap.lot_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.serial_no) AS appliances, COUNT(DISTINCT c.serial_no) AS appliances_failed, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.serial_no) / COUNT(DISTINCT ap.serial_no), 2) AS failure_share FROM appliance_parts ap LEFT JOIN complaints c ON c.serial_no = ap.serial_no AND c.suspected_component = 'SSD' WHERE ap.part_no LIKE 'SSD-%' GROUP BY ap.lot_no ORDER BY failure_share DESC, ap.lot_no;

question: 已公告停產的零件，在各站點還有幾台服役中的主機在用？
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_no, p.last_time_buy_date, a.site_id, COUNT(*) AS appliances FROM parts p JOIN appliance_parts ap ON ap.part_no = p.part_no JOIN appliances a ON a.serial_no = ap.serial_no WHERE p.lifecycle_status = 'eol_announced' AND a.status = 'in_service' GROUP BY p.part_no, p.last_time_buy_date, a.site_id ORDER BY a.site_id;

question: 每台推論主機目前跑的軟體版本是什麼？
gold_sql: SELECT a.site_id, a.serial_no, dep.version, dep.deployed_at FROM appliances a JOIN deployments dep ON dep.serial_no = a.serial_no WHERE dep.deployed_at = (SELECT MAX(d2.deployed_at) FROM deployments d2 WHERE d2.serial_no = a.serial_no) ORDER BY a.site_id, a.serial_no;

question: 有哪些 CAPA 已經過了到期日但還沒結案？
gold_sql: SELECT capa_id, title, due_date, status, owner_role FROM capas WHERE status <> 'closed' AND due_date < '2026-09-30' ORDER BY due_date;

question: 各區域各有幾家站點？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS sites FROM sites GROUP BY region

question: 2026-09 各站點處理了多少件檢查？
gold_sql: SELECT site_id, studies_processed FROM monthly_usage WHERE month = '2026-09'

question: 2026-09 QC 拒收率超過 5% 的站點有哪些？拒收率多少？
gold_sql: SELECT site_id, qc_reject_rate FROM monthly_usage WHERE month = '2026-09' AND qc_reject_rate > 0.05

question: 還沒結案的客訴，各類別有幾件？
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM complaints WHERE status <> 'closed' GROUP BY category

question: 每個軟體版本目前裝在幾台主機上？
gold_sql: SELECT dep.version, COUNT(*) AS appliances FROM appliances a JOIN deployments dep ON dep.serial_no = a.serial_no WHERE dep.deployed_at = (SELECT MAX(d2.deployed_at) FROM deployments d2 WHERE d2.serial_no = a.serial_no) GROUP BY dep.version

question: 哪些授權會在今天之後、2026 年底以前到期？
gold_sql: SELECT license_id, site_id, end_date FROM licenses WHERE end_date > '2026-09-30' AND end_date <= '2026-12-31'

question: 目前有效的授權，各站點的年費合計是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT site_id, SUM(annual_fee_twd) AS annual_fee FROM licenses WHERE start_date <= '2026-09-30' AND end_date >= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY site_id

question: 2026 年每個月收到幾件客訴？
gold_sql: SELECT substr(received_at, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM complaints WHERE received_at >= '2026-01-01' AND received_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY month

question: 每個 CAPA 關聯了幾件客訴？
gold_sql: SELECT cp.capa_id, COUNT(c.complaint_id) AS complaints FROM capas cp LEFT JOIN complaints c ON c.capa_id = cp.capa_id GROUP BY cp.capa_id

question: 2026-09 平均推論延遲最高的 3 個站點是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT site_id, mean_latency_s FROM monthly_usage WHERE month = '2026-09' ORDER BY mean_latency_s DESC LIMIT 3

question: 還沒核准的設計變更申請有哪些？各關聯哪個零件或軟體版本？
gold_sql: SELECT ecr_id, title, status, related_part_no, related_version FROM change_requests WHERE status <> 'approved'
